title: Composition coherence of inverse-image comparisons
statement: Given arbitrary categories Xr, Sr, Tr, Xs, Ss, Ts; restriction functors Lar:Xr→Sr, Lbr:Sr→Tr, Labr:Xr→Tr, Las:Xs→Ss, Lbs:Ss→Ts, Labs:Xs→Ts; isomorphisms cr:Labr≅Lar⋙Lbr and cs:Labs≅Las⋙Lbs; coefficient functors FX:Xr→Xs, FS:Sr→Ss, FT:Tr→Ts; and comparisons qa:FX⋙Las≅Lar⋙FS, qb:FS⋙Lbs≅Lbr⋙FT, qab:FX⋙Labs≅Labr⋙FT, define immersionComparisonComposition to mean that for every M in Xr, qab.hom.app M ≫ FT.map(cr.hom.app M) = cs.hom.app(FX.obj M) ≫ Lbs.map(qa.hom.app M) ≫ qb.hom.app(Lar.obj M). This specifies only q-composition coherence and supplies no comparison data.

def immersionComparisonComposition
    {Xr Sr Tr Xs Ss Ts : Type*}
    [Category Xr] [Category Sr] [Category Tr] [Category Xs] [Category Ss] [Category Ts]
    (Lar : Xr ⥤ Sr) (Lbr : Sr ⥤ Tr) (Labr : Xr ⥤ Tr)
    (Las : Xs ⥤ Ss) (Lbs : Ss ⥤ Ts) (Labs : Xs ⥤ Ts)
    (cr : Labr ≅ Lar ⋙ Lbr) (cs : Labs ≅ Las ⋙ Lbs)
    (FX : Xr ⥤ Xs) (FS : Sr ⥤ Ss) (FT : Tr ⥤ Ts)
    (qa : FX ⋙ Las ≅ Lar ⋙ FS) (qb : FS ⋙ Lbs ≅ Lbr ⋙ FT)
    (qab : FX ⋙ Labs ≅ Labr ⋙ FT) : Prop
